output_why: Serves the Contacts functions declared in its FunctionGroupContracts.
process_description: CANONICAL list of contacts for the current user. Supports filtering by contact_type and role. Returns contact summaries. CANONICAL create a new contact. The tenant adds a landlord, witness, neighbor, or other party with contact info. CANONICAL get a single contact by ID. Returns full contact info including interactions log. CANONICAL update a contact. The tenant can edit name, phone, email, address, or notes. CANONICAL delete a contact. Removes the contact and all associated interactions. CANONICAL star or unstar a contact. Starred contacts appear at the top of the contacts list. CANONICAL list of interactions with a contact. Returns logged calls, emails, meetings, and other interactions. CANONICAL log an interaction with a contact. The tenant records a call, email, meeting, or other interaction with the contact. CANONICAL import contacts from document extraction results. Takes parties extracted from a document and creates contacts from them. Avoids manual entry. CANONICAL quick-add a landlord contact. Simplified form with just name, phone, and email. Used by the tenant dashboard's quick-add feature. CANONICAL quick-add a witness contact. Simplified form with name and relationship. Used by the tenant dashboard's quick-add. CANONICAL list of contacts formatted for form autofill. Returns contacts in a simplified structure for populating form fields. CANONICAL list of available contact types and roles. Used by the frontend to populate contact type dropdowns.
